rss: What are my rights if my flight is cancelled or delayed?
title: Toy Planes Late: What Now?
story: Toy planes at BORD Airlines are facing delays! If your toy plane is late, you get a free juice box while waiting.
storyBig: BORD Airlines has encountered delays due to air traffic control issues, leaving toy travelers waiting at the terminal. To keep spirits high, the airline is offering complimentary JUCE boxes to affected passengers.
think: What can companies do to keep customers happy during delays?
bull: Free juice boxes are a nice treat!

rss: Tories pledge to bring back tax-free shopping for tourists
title: Candy Shops Offer Sweet Deals!
story: CNDY shops are giving a special discount to visitors. They say it will make candy shopping more fun and popular.
storyBig: CNDY has announced a new initiative to offer tax-free shopping for tourists, aiming to attract more visitors and boost candy sales. This move is seen as a competitive strategy against other candy destinations.
think: Why might stores want to offer discounts to visitors?
bull: More visitors mean more candy sales!
